Freemint on ZEC 11 spots. 
All the projects on Zcash turned out to be rugs except ZecBit. Zec Punks is supposed to launch in the next few days, and I think it’s going to be a rug too. Even though it’s a free mint, it’s still Dyor. We should wait for the ZecBit projects to launch maybe there won’t be as many rugs then.
